core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix video tech with cinematic aesthetics
Emotion First: Focus, clarity, and reliability
Content is King: The video feed is the hero
Negative Space: Reduce cognitive load in meetings
anti_patterns: Purple/Teal gradients everywhere (Use solid vibrant accents)
Inter font for headings (Use IBM Plex Sans)
Pure black backgrounds (Use deep blue-tinted charcoal)

bento_grid.description: Asymmetric grid for video feeds and panels
rules: Speaker Focus Mode: Main speaker takes 'col-span-9 row-span-full', sidebar takes 'col-span-3'
Gallery Mode: Uniform 'col-span-4' or 'col-span-3' based on participant count
Control Bar: Floating, persistent at bottom, 'z-50'

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-accent rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all shadow-glow hover:scale-105
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all
buttons.destructive: bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90 rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.icon_control: w-12 h-12 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center bg-secondary hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground transition-all duration-300 shadow-lg

cards.base: bg-card border border-white/5 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-floating backdrop-blur-sm

inputs.base: bg-input border-transparent focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground transition-all

video_tile.base: relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black aspect-video group border border-transparent hover:border-white/10 transition-all

general: Implement the 'blue-tinted' dark theme strictly. No pure greys.
Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Use specific transitions.
For the Video Grid, use a responsive grid that adapts to participant count.
The Control Bar must be 'fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2' with a glass effect.

specific_pages.meeting_room: Implement Bento Grid layout. Main area for video, collapsible side panels for Chat/Participants. Use <Split> or Resizable panels if possible, or CSS Grid.
specific_pages.lobby: Clean, centered card for audio/video check. Background should be one of the office images with overlay.
specific_pages.dashboard: Use cards to show 'Upcoming Meetings', 'Recent Recordings'. Use the 'Trace Beam' effect on these cards.

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
